page.layout: One scanned image: the front board of a bound volume covered in red patterned paper, with a spine label strip on the left edge. No printed text block on this page.
page.notes: The scan shows a decorative red and cream patterned cover (bookbinding paper), not a printed page. The spine label at the left edge carries only fragments of gilt lettering (partly visible "OS", "A", "OI" and "L VE" on the spine label strips), which are cut off by the scan edge and cannot be read reliably. A white paper label with a handwritten or printed number fragment ("2") sits on the lower left edge. None of this is printed text of the book itself, so nothing is transcribed.
